objects.summary: Codex accepts B4 erratum E1-E3 without expanding authority: adjusted-open execution basis, fail-closed trial-count fallback, and closed metric definitions. Only harness construction/review is allowed, not execution.
Builder publishes non-executed B4 harness with 29 synthetic/adversarial tests and explicitly exposes remaining design choices for challenge before real data execution.

Automated review finds raw CSV lines were parsed before shadow cutoff. Builder fixes filtering before CSV field parsing, adds tests, and discloses the same bounded parsing defect in already-run B2 without rerunning B2 or overstating its guarantees.
Two more P2 findings are accepted: registry-vs-STATE conflict must fail closed and metadata identity/coherence must be checked before calculation. Harness remains non-executed; 35 tests pass.

Further review finds tie-break implementation and late filesystem mutation handling defects. Both are fixed; harness reaches 40 tests. Proposed freeze rule: only defects that can change result, selection or data boundary postpone execution; pure style does not.
Codex code-review usage limit is reached, creating an external tool-availability interruption in the challenge lane.

Builder issues one bounded reminder after review quota interruption; if no reply, H7 becomes NON_REPONDU and one execution proceeds with explicitly accepted residual risk after 40 tests and five review passes.

B4 executes once and returns FAMILY_REJECTED. L=252 has net +6.69% but t=0.488 vs 3.227 required, fails split stability and concentration; it underperforms passive comparators. No fifth variant. Local panel is declared exhausted for honest low-cost new evidence; new public data is Owner-gated Q30.

cross_object_findings.finding: B4 accumulated multiple material pre-execution fixes across price basis, trial-count provenance, metric definitions, shadow parsing, metadata, selection tie-break and mutation handling before the single real run.
A later shadow-line parsing issue was disclosed for B2 without pretending the original stronger wording remained proven and without rerunning a spent experiment.
Codex review quota exhaustion interrupted H7; the eventual execution explicitly records NON_REPONDU and residual risk rather than treating silence as review PASS.
MACRO-TSMOM-001 is rejected on the preregistered conjunction despite positive raw net return; no fifth lookback or retune is allowed.

After B2 and B4, the team records that no honest low-cost fresh validation remains on the local panel; further distinct edge exploration requires Owner-gated new public data rather than recycling spent windows.
